query.commandtext: SELECT A.FACTORY, :DEFECT_TYPE DEFECT_TYPE, A.EQUIP_ID, :PRODUCT PRODUCT, :STEP_ID STEP_ID, LOWER, TARGET, UPPER, CASE USE_FLAG WHEN NULL THEN 1 WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END USE_FLAG, CREATE_USER, TO_CHAR(B.CREATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, TO_CHAR(B.UPDATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') UPDATE_TIME FROM TQC_EQUIP A, ( SELECT * FROM TQD_ALARM_SETUP WHERE 1=1 AND DEFECT_TYPE = :DEFECT_TYPE AND PRODUCT = :PRODUCT AND STEP_ID = :STEP_ID ) B WHERE A.FACTORY = B.FACTORY(+) AND A.EQUIP_ID = B.EQUIP_ID(+) AND A.OPER = 'Inspection' ORDER BY A.EQUIP_ID

INSERT INTO TQD_ALARM_DATA ( FACTORY, DEFECT_TYPE, PRODUCT, STEP_ID, EQUIP_ID, TRAN_TIME, STEP_SEQ, LOWER, TARGET, UPPER, ALARM_YN, ALARM_TYPE, DEFECT_COUNT, NOTI_USER ) VALUES ( :FACTORY, :DEFECT_TYPE, :PRODUCT, :STEP_ID, :EQUIP_ID, SYSDATE, :STEP_SEQ, :LOWER, :TARGET, :UPPER, :ALARM_YN, :ALARM_TYPE, :DEFECT_COUNT, :NOTI_USER )

SELECT FACTORY, DEFECT_TYPE, PRODUCT, STEP_ID, EQUIP_ID, TO_CHAR(TRAN_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') TRAN_TIME, WAFER_ID, LOWER, TARGET, UPPER, DEFECT_COUNT, ALARM_YN, ALARM_TYPE, NOTI_USER FROM ( SELECT A.*, (SELECT WAFER_ID FROM TQD_INSP_INFO WHERE STEP_SEQ = A.STEP_SEQ) WAFER_ID FROM TQD_ALARM_DATA A WHERE FACTORY = :FACTORY AND DEFECT_TYPE = :DEFECT_TYPE AND EQUIP_ID = :EQUIP_ID AND PRODUCT = :PRODUCT AND STEP_ID = :STEP_ID ORDER BY TRAN_TIME DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM < :NUM
